import re

import sqlite3

def handle_skill_remover(cmd, cmd_line, ask_ai_fn):
    # Check if any of the specified triggers are present in the command line
    if any(t in cmd_line.lower() for t in ["удалить", "скрипт", "файл", "команду", "выбор"]):
        try:
            # Extract the skill name from the command line using regex
            match = re.search(r"(?:удалить|создать|редактировать)\s+(\w+)", cmd_line, re.IGNORECASE)
            if match:
                skill_name = match.group(1)
                
                # Connect to the SQLite database
                conn = sqlite3.connect('skills.db')
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                
                # Delete the specified skill from the database
                cursor.execute("DELETE FROM skills WHERE name=?", (skill_name,))
                
                # Commit the changes and close the connection
                conn.commit()
                conn.close()
                
                print(f"Skill '{skill_name}' has been removed.")
                return True
        except sqlite3.Error as e:
            print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
            return False
    else:
        print("No skill command found.")
        return False
